description: Snapshot for 30 global equity indices plus Hong Kong indices (e.g. 日经225 GIDX:NKY, 标普500 GIDX:SPX, 纳斯达克 GIDX:IXIC, 恒生指数 HKEX:HSI). A-share indices are `index_snapshot`. For Hong Kong indices read `quote_status` (live, last_quote, unavailable). For other markets read `data_tier`: `realtime` = trading now; `closed` / `warm` / `daily` / `stale_cache` = a previous close, never report as live; `unavailable` = no data. `is_stale` is true for everything except `realtime`; `meta.realtime_count` / `meta.closed_count` give the split. `market_trade_date` is each market's LOCAL trading day — never compare it with a Beijing date. `volume` null = not published.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

codes.description: Canonical codes to narrow the snapshot (e.g. ['GIDX:NKY', 'HKEX:HSI']); omit for all 30

region.description: Filter by region; combine with `codes` to narrow further. Omit for all regions

name: global_index_snapshot
